title: Runtime quickfire sync agenda (thin)
content:
Purpose: a super-lean agenda for Thu weekly runtime/infra/console sync. Keep to 30–35 minutes, triage three things: perf regressions, rollout blockers, and console observability gaps. This is my personal quickprep so I can lead a focused meeting and capture action items quickly.

Meeting details:
- When: Thu 2026-03-12, 10:00–10:35 PT (block 35m)
- Where: #runtime-ops (Zoom link in calendar)
- Attendees invited: runtime leads, infra on-call, console product engineer, SRE rep (approx 8–10)
- Goal: make one measurable decision (canary rollout or rollback) and leave with owner+due for top 3 items.

Quick metrics snapshot (bring numbers, not slides):
- 95p latency (text-gen w/ Redwood-7B-int8): target <=150ms; current 162ms (↑12ms last 24h)
- p99 token latency: target <=420ms; current 470ms (spike after midnight)
- Error budget burn (hosted): 6% in last 7d, alert threshold 5%
- Dedicated cluster utilization (eu-west-1-dedicated-1): 78%

Opening (5m)
- Quick round: 1 sentence per person — blockers or hot items. (I call on folks: Kai -> infra, Emilia -> console, Ravi -> SRE)
- Confirm timebox and decision goal.

Main topics (25m total)
1) Nightly p99 spike (10m) — owner: Kai
   - Symptoms: p99 token latency increase from 420 -> 470ms at ~01:30 UTC.
   - Hypotheses: GC pauses on orchestration VM; new model variant fallback path causing cache misses; autoscaler flapping during low traffic.
   - Quick checks to run live: check container GC logs (LAST_24H GC lines), inspect fallback logs /var/log/redwood/fallback.log for 01:20–01:40, confirm autoscaler events in kube-events.
   - Decision goal: either roll back the variant or pin model variant to previous image for next 6h.
   - Pre-reads: INF-2345 (linked), GH PR 987 for KV cache fix.

2) Canary rollout stuck (8m) — owner: Emilia
   - Status: console rollout shows 37% success rate on canary route; some 500s from routing layer.
   - Immediate ask: collect 3 representative request traces and route configs; enable debug logs for 15m to capture sticky session behavior.
   - Decision goal: continue canary with additional logging OR abort and revert to previous routing policy.

3) Console dashboard gaps & UX note (7m) — owner: Noelle (me)
   - Issue: cost-per-token breakdown missing for dedicated pools (customers asking). Patch exists but not surfaced in UI.
   - Quick win: expose a toggle in /metrics -> show dedicated cost rows; patch PR exists in GH PR 1004 (needs review + small backend change).
   - Decision goal: ship toggle behind feature flag for next deploy window.

Parking lot (only touch if time)
- Request from solutions-eng: short how-to for private deployments cost estimation (defer to next week).
- Proposal: cap burst capacity by default for new Dedicated customers (needs pricing input).

Action items (capture live; I prepend initials to make it readable)
- NOELLE: Open PR review for GH PR 1004 and assign to console-frontend (due 2026-03-13).
- KAI: Run GC and autoscaler checks, paste summary into INF-2345 and tag me (due 2026-03-12 EOD).
- EMILIA: Collect 3 failing traces for canary route, toggle debug logs during next 10:30–10:45 window, update rollout status in rollout dashboard (due 2026-03-12).
- RAVI (SRE): If autoscaler flapping confirmed, apply temp scaling-policy override (document in infra runbook) and notify infra-oncall (due 2026-03-12 22:00 UTC).
- KAI + NOELLE: If fallback logs show cache miss regression, coordinate immediate rollback and postmortem owner (due 2026-03-12 within 2h of decision).

Notes to self / facilitation script:
- Keep agenda visible in Zoom window share; call out "Decision goal" explicitly before each discussion.
- Timekeeper: pick someone (ask at start) — default to Emilia. If not, I'll step in.
- When we assign an action, confirm owner and due date out loud and add to the channel thread.
- Capture small follow-ups as separate Slack thread so we don't bloat meeting notes.

Follow-ups after meeting (my checklist)
- Post concise notes + actions to #runtime-ops thread (include links to INF-2345, PRs, traces).
- Update rollout dashboard card for canary change.
- If rollback executed, schedule 30m postmortem sync next day and assign primary author for postmortem (sprint template).

Questions I want to ask in meeting (notes for 1:1 or manager later)
- Do we want to adjust the nightly autoscaler cooldown to avoid oscillation? (Pros/cons and cost impact)
- Should cost breakdown for Dedicated be prioritized above small UX polish? Customer asks seem to justify priority but we need product buy-in.

Misc scratch (short reminders)
- Revisit batching config suggestion from Optimize team next week.
- Remind Tina (solutions-eng) to run the private deployment cost demo during customer call on Mon.

End of quickfire prep. Keep this doc minimal; convert to meeting notes after sync and then rename and move to shared_drives/engineering/serving-runtime if we want an exec-safe summary.
